query:
SELECT tl.label_id AS "label_id!",
               COUNT(*) AS "total!: i64",
               SUM(t.unread_count > 0) AS "unread!: i64"
        FROM thread_labels tl
        JOIN threads t ON t.account_id = tl.account_id AND t.id = tl.thread_id
        WHERE tl.account_id = ?
        GROUP BY tl.label_id
        ORDER BY tl.label_id
